data.name: Intro
data.value: Makes the Killit app the Device Owner of your phone. On the phone, turn on USB debugging in Developer options, connect it with a USB cable and accept the “Allow USB debugging?” prompt.

data.name: StateUnauthorized
data.value: Waiting for permission – accept the prompt on the phone

data.name: BlockersHint
data.value: Remove every item below on the phone, in Settings (Accounts, and Users or Multiple users), then press Check again.

data.name: StatusNoDevices
data.value: No phone found. Check the USB cable, make sure USB debugging is on and the USB driver for your phone is installed, then press Refresh.

data.name: StatusDevicesFound
data.value: Phones found: {0}. Select one and press Check.

data.name: StatusKillitMissing
data.value: Killit is not installed on this phone. Install it first, then press Check again.

data.name: StatusOwnerExists
data.value: This phone already has a Device Owner ({0}). A phone can only have one, so it has to be factory reset before Killit can become Device Owner.

data.name: StatusBlockersFound
data.value: Items to remove: {0}. Remove them on the phone, then press Check again.

data.name: StatusReady
data.value: The phone is ready. Press Authenticate to make Killit the Device Owner.

data.name: StatusSuccess
data.value: Done! Killit is now the Device Owner of this phone. You can unplug it.

data.name: StatusVerifyFailed
data.value: The phone reported success, but Killit could not be confirmed as Device Owner. Press Check to look again.

data.name: StatusFailed
data.value: Android refused to make Killit the Device Owner.

data.name: HintAccounts
data.value: There are still accounts on the phone. Remove them and press Check again.

data.name: HintUsers
data.value: There are still other users or a work profile on the phone. Remove them and press Check again.

data.name: HintOwnerSet
data.value: The phone already has a Device Owner. It has to be factory reset first.

data.name: HintSecurity
data.value: This phone needs one more setting: in Developer options also turn on “USB debugging (Security settings)” (Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO), then try again.

data.name: HintUnknownAdmin
data.value: The Killit version on this phone is not compatible. Update Killit and try again.

data.name: StatusDeviceLost
data.value: Lost the connection to the phone ({0}). Reconnect it and press Refresh.

data.name: StatusAdbMissing
data.value: adb could not be started ({0}). Reinstall Killit Desktop Authenticator.

data.name: StatusRuntimeMissing
data.value: adb could not start because the Windows update KB2999226 (Universal C Runtime) is missing. Install it with Windows Update or reinstall this program, then start it again.
